stem.text: The table shows the Michaelis–Menten constant, $K_\text{m}$, for three enzymes.
Which interpretation of the information is correct?

A.text: Enzyme C has a $V_\text{max}$ which is half that of enzyme P.

B.text: Enzyme C will reach $V_\text{max}$ in the shortest time interval.

C.text: Enzyme F has the greatest affinity for its substrate.

D.text: Enzyme P has a $V_\text{max}$ of $6.0 \times 10^{-3}\,\text{mmol dm}^{-3}$.
